server.name: community-letin
server.version: letin (npm latest at image build time)
server.note: Drawn in frame order at position 585 of Frame 3, block 5. Thirty one tools; the mutating ones edit Power Query M in a source. Excel and Power BI Desktop sources need Windows, so every fixture uses the documented folder-of-.pq-files source, seeded in the trial root. The automatic pre-write snapshots go under HOME and are not observed. pq-manifest.json is observed as a JSON document with its updated_at stamp declared away; the .pq files are observed by bytes.

fixtures.note: Creates a query by name, or replaces it if it exists. probe_stable is set: the read tool's reply carries the source location, query names, M text and step lists only, checked against its actual output.
